description: Nucleotide margin, synonymous/nonsynonymous partition, and C. elegans orthology for the H. contortus beta-tubulin loci
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()
N=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"nucleotide_CDS_comparison.tsv"),sep="\t")
M=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"celegans_orthology_identity.tsv"),sep="\t",index_col=0)
P=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"Q25022_alignment_table_WBPS19.tsv"),sep="\t")

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,8.4))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1],width_ratios=[1,1.15],hspace=0.46,wspace=0.28)

# --- A: protein vs nucleotide margin ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
loci=["HCON_00043670\nisotype-2, chr II","HCON_00005260\nisotype-1, chr I"]
prot=[99.55,94.20]
nt  =[98.52,79.36]
x=np.arange(2); w=0.36
ax.bar(x-w/2,prot,w,label="protein identity",color="#8fb3a2")
ax.bar(x+w/2,nt,w,label="CDS nucleotide identity",color="#2f6f4e")
for i,(p,n) in enumerate(zip(prot,nt)):
    ax.text(i-w/2,p+0.8,f"{p:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=10)
    ax.text(i+w/2,n+0.8,f"{n:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(loci,fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(70,106); ax.set_ylabel("% identity to the tub12-16 cDNA (M76491 / Q25022)")
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9.5,loc="lower left")
ax.set_title("Nucleotide divergence separates the two loci\nfar more sharply than protein identity",fontsize=11.5,loc="left")
ax.annotate("",xy=(1.18,98.52),xytext=(1.18,79.36),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->",color="#b3453a",lw=1.6))
ax.text(1.26,89,"19.16 pp\nnucleotide\nmargin",color="#b3453a",fontsize=9.5,va="center")
ax.text(-0.42,101.5,"5.35 pp protein margin",color="#6b7580",fontsize=9)
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=0.3); ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# --- B: synonymous vs nonsynonymous ---
ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
sub=N.dropna(subset=["nt_diffs"]).copy()
sub["lab"]=sub["query"].str.split(" ").str[0]+"\nvs "+sub["subject"].str.replace("-00001","",regex=False)
sub=sub.iloc[::-1]
ax2.barh(sub["lab"],sub["synonymous"],color="#2f6f4e",label="synonymous")
ax2.barh(sub["lab"],sub["nonsynonymous"],left=sub["synonymous"],color="#b3453a",label="nonsynonymous")
for i,(s_,ns) in enumerate(zip(sub["synonymous"],sub["nonsynonymous"])):
    ax2.text(s_+ns+5,i,f"{int(s_)} syn + {int(ns)} nonsyn",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel("nucleotide differences over the 1347-nt CDS")
ax2.set_xlim(0,340); ax2.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9,loc="lower right")
ax2.set_title("Allelic comparisons (14-20 differences, ~90 % synonymous)\nversus paralog comparisons (271-278 differences)",fontsize=11.5,loc="left")
ax2.tick_params(labelsize=8.5)
for s in ["top","right"]: ax2.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# --- C: C. elegans orthology heatmap ---
ax3=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
Mp=M.drop(columns=[c for c in M.columns if "tbb-6" in c])
im=ax3.imshow(Mp.values.astype(float),cmap="YlGnBu",vmin=85,vmax=100,aspect="auto")
ax3.set_xticks(range(Mp.shape[1])); ax3.set_xticklabels([c.split(" (")[0] for c in Mp.columns],fontsize=10)
ax3.set_yticks(range(Mp.shape[0])); ax3.set_yticklabels(Mp.index,fontsize=9.5)
for i in range(Mp.shape[0]):
    for j in range(Mp.shape[1]):
        v=Mp.values[i,j]
        ax3.text(j,i,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,
                 color="white" if v>94 else "#22303a",
                 weight="bold" if v==Mp.values[i].max() else "normal")
ax3.set_title("Identity to the C. elegans beta-tubulin family: the chr X genes are 1:1 orthologs of tbb-4 and mec-7,\n"
              "while isotype-1 and isotype-2 are co-orthologs of the ben-1 / tbb-1 / tbb-2 clade and cannot be split by orthology",
              fontsize=11,loc="left")
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax3,fraction=0.025,pad=0.01,label="% identity")
plt.show()
